title: Laya
purpose: 多語言的 System 1 decision engine：不是生成文字，而是用單次 forward pass 對輸入狀態回答 typed decisions，包括 choice、score 與二元概率（noul）。內建 Router 可依語言／script 選擇 checkpoint，也提供 model routing、prompt guardrail、moderation、support triage 等 preset。
recommendation: 適合把高頻、低延遲、結構化的分類／風險／路由決策從大型生成式模型前面拆出來，先用快速 decision layer 判斷，再決定是否呼叫昂貴的 System 2 LLM 或升級人工處理。
notes: Official repository confirmed. README positions Laya as a multilingual non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine. It supports calibrated probabilities and confidence gating, but the author explicitly notes important limits: base checkpoints are weak zero-shot on the typed-decisions benchmark, high-cardinality choices need tuning/shortlisting, and multilingual confidence should be calibrated before relying on it.
